edit.description: groomAgent.invoke (readFileSync BACKLOG_PATH) and backlogParseGate.run (readFileSync BACKLOG_PATH) each catch-all and report 'nothing to groom' / ok:true on any error, not just missing-file. Narrow both to err.code === 'ENOENT', rethrow otherwise — matches existing convention (src/Baton.ts:56, src/builtinGates.ts:49, src/Agent.ts:173, src/Dispatcher.ts:2257).
Add a case where BACKLOG_PATH exists as a directory (a real, non-ENOENT readFileSync failure) and assert the tick surfaces it instead of reporting 'no backlog' / gate ok:true.

summary: Narrow backlog-groomer-chain's bare try/catch to ENOENT-only; other I/O errors are silently treated as 'no backlog', masking real failures.

tests.asserts: a non-ENOENT BACKLOG.json read failure (path is a directory) propagates/fails the tick rather than being reported as 'no backlog to groom'.

acceptance: New test fails on pre-fix tree (EISDIR swallowed as a no-op 'nothing to groom') and passes once both catch sites in examples/backlog-groomer-chain.ts narrow to ENOENT.
notes: This file is the one users are told to copy verbatim into their own .flume/chain.ts (trailing block), so the swallow-all-errors pattern propagates to every downstream chain that copies it.
